content_text: Hello, Mr. Deakins. I hope everything is going well for you. Please forgive my poor English. I’ve watched some of the movies you recommended on the website and in ASC Magazine, such as “The Quiet Girl”, “Army of Shadows”, “American Fiction”… I found that I like every single one of the movies you recommended so much. I really hope that you can specifically talk about everything related to the movies that interest you in the future. For me, it’s extremely meaningful to listen to you discussing movies, because you have always been my idol and an example for me to learn from. I’m really looking forward to hearing you recommend some movies to all of us and your thoughts on them!!
